title: ae_readback
description: Read back the After Effects project that was just built, to compare with the plan (motion_readback.compare): every scene comp's layer span in MAIN and its layers' text, font, composer, direction and box.

job.description: the same job that was built; only job.plan is read

data.description: {job}: the job that was built (motion_build.build sends the same one to readback).

id.description: scene id; matched with plan scenes

in_frame.description: scene layer in-point in MAIN (plan start_frame); null when the layer is missing

out_frame.description: scene layer out-point in MAIN (plan layer_out_frame); null when missing

scenes.description: A scene whose comp does not exist is absent; motion_readback.compare reports it missing.

missing_or_substituted.description: PostScript names After Effects reports as missing or substituted (app.fonts.missingOrSubstitutedFonts)

readback.description: What the open project holds. ok:false (MAIN comp not found) carries {reason} as readback_failure.

reason.description: e.g. 'MAIN_<id> not found in the open project'

layer.description: One layer of a scene comp: a text layer (full read-back) or a shape/other layer.

name.description: layer name; text layers are matched with the plan element name

in.description: first frame in the scene comp

out.description: last frame in the scene comp

comment.description: layer comment; for text layers the plan's word-cue hash (motion_readback.compare cue_hash)

text.description: the text as After Effects holds it (motion_readback.compare compares it with the plan)

font_ps.description: PostScript name actually used (compare: must equal the plan's font_ps)

substitute.description: After Effects substituted the font because it is not installed (compare fails the build)

composer.description: 'UNIVERSAL' (Middle Eastern composer, needed for Arabic) or 'LATIN'; null when unreadable

direction.description: paragraph direction 'RTL' | 'LTR' from the TextDocument; null when unreadable

direction_pr.description: direction from paragraphRange(0), an alternative to direction in motion_readback.compare. Optional: the JSX omits it when paragraphRange(0).direction throws (the After Effects 25.2 fallback path); when present it is a string or null

rect.description: [left, top, width, height] in comp pixels at the hero frame; absent when rect_error is set

rect_error.description: why rect could not be measured

text_layer.description: A text layer. Every field motion_readback.compare reads is required except direction_pr (an optional alternative to direction) and rect / rect_error (safe-area and overlap checks, optional).

name.description: layer name; text layers are matched with the plan element name

in.description: first frame in the scene comp

out.description: last frame in the scene comp

comment.description: layer comment; for text layers the plan's word-cue hash (motion_readback.compare cue_hash)

other_layer.description: A shape or other non-text layer: only its name and frame span are read back.
